text:
```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
      run: |
        /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
        brew install --quiet --force openssl libffi
        echo "export PATH=/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin:$PATH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "export LDFLAGS=-L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "export CPPFLAGS=-I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Create virtual environment
      run: python -m venv venv
      env:
        VIRTUAL_ENV: venv

    - name: Activate virtual environment
      run: source venv/bin/activate
      env:
        VIRTUAL_ENV: venv

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
      run: ./pyinstaller.sh

    - name: Archive artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-app-bundle
        path: dist/SSHPilot.app
        retention-days: 30

    - name: Archive DMG
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-dmg
        path: dist/sshpilot.dmg
        retention-days: 30

    - name: Archive checksum
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: ss hpilot-checksum
        path: dist/sshpilot.sha256
        retention-days: 30
```
